purpose: Design of the start-plan orchestrator workflow that derives an implementation strategy from design docs, extracts tasks, and creates a plan document, including the agent data exchange.
summary: Orchestrator overview and delegation of strategy drafting to the plan-strategist custom Agent
Agent data exchange via request JSON, strategy file and exit value, with identifiers output_dir and feature
The four strategy_exchange.py subcommands: open, request-path, finish, check
Flowchart from prerequisites through context collection, document reading, strategy, plan creation, review and commit
Phase 1 context collection with query-db-specs and query-db-rules; design doc required, requirements optional
Phase 2 document reading, temporary-feature marker detection and related existing spec search
Phase 3 strategy drafting, user approval, and handling of additive development differences
Phase 4 plan creation via write_plan.py, task granularity, required_reading and completeness checks
Phase 5 AI review and completion steps (update-db-specs, commit)
Design principles: task per Agent, traceability matrix, existing asset check in update mode
tasks: Designing or changing plan-strategist agent behavior
Changing strategy_exchange.py or the request/result exchange
Defining task granularity and required_reading for plans
